SELECT island_id FROM experiment WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

WITH RECURSIVE res AS ( SELECT DISTINCT wn.resource_id AS id FROM workflow_node wn WHERE wn.workflow_id = #{param1} AND wn.resource_id IS NOT NULL ), up AS ( SELECT rn.id, rn.parent_id, rn.kind::text AS kind FROM resource_node rn JOIN res ON res.id = rn.id UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.kind::text FROM resource_node p JOIN up ON p.id = up.parent_id ) SELECT id FROM up WHERE kind = 'island' LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE wf AS ( SELECT ep.workflow_id FROM experiment_process ep WHERE ep.tenant_id = #{param1} AND ep.experiment_id = #{param2} ), res AS ( SELECT DISTINCT wn.resource_id AS id FROM workflow_node wn JOIN wf ON wf.workflow_id = wn.workflow_id WHERE wn.resource_id IS NOT NULL ), up AS ( SELECT rn.id, rn.parent_id, rn.kind::text AS kind FROM resource_node rn JOIN res ON res.id = rn.id UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.kind::text FROM resource_node p JOIN up ON p.id = up.parent_id ) SELECT DISTINCT id FROM up WHERE kind = 'island'
